evidence_notice: Appearance in an email, photograph, contact record, flight record or released document does not by itself establish misconduct. Matrix Reprogrammed separates documented contact, supported inference and unresolved leads.

methodology.source_policy: Every published relationship must retain a route to the exact supporting record and underlying release provenance.
methodology.identity_policy: Names are not merged by surname alone. Email identity, aliases, role, employer, thread context and corroborating records are assessed separately.
methodology.publication_policy: Only human-approved entities, relationships, events and financial records may enter this file.
methodology.relationship_policy: A mention, copied recipient and direct correspondent are distinct evidence states.
methodology.financial_policy: Proposed, discussed and completed investments or transactions are never collapsed into one status.
